venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Wed 7/15 (MOD: MKZ/JK).** Happy National Hot Dog Day! Net sales $2,327 beat the $1,316 target (+77%) on 66 guests / $35.26 check avg. Started as a quiet Wednesday but saw familiar faces; opener set the bar up and handled weekend batches. Nice push around 9:30pm, smooth close with MOD support. Kitchen had a very busy shift. Food $673, comps $56.50. 86 towels, low olives; need to pull coupe and Collins glasses before the weekend. No incidents. Favorite moment: neighbors from Giving Kitchen event stopping by.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Wed 7/15 (MOD: KK & MD / Chef JMS).** Smooth Wednesday service. Net sales $1,460 beat the $1,018 target (+43%) on 48 guests / $30.43 check avg. Only identifiable pop was the Real Estate team Happy Hour at 4:30pm; friend of G&L Amber in with regular Peyton. Slower pace 9pm–11:30pm with a few last-call groups. Food $193, comps $58.20 (3.9%, marketing). Note: Check #55 closed as partial payment, left open to adjust — Kira informed. Well 4 chiller should be fixed tomorrow. Low: Patron Silver, Montenegro, Rosé, N/A beer. Favorite moment: a few first-date couples in tonight.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Wed 7/15 (PM MOD: Maggie S; Chef Nate).** Easy, slow night top to bottom. Net sales $10,475.21 fell just short of the $11,421 target (92%) on 201 guests / ~$52.11 check avg. Splits: DC/AM $1,109.40 (early closure for DCAM meeting, no report), D&C PM $9,365.73, Garden/6A $2,021.62. Food $2,219. Comps $242.45 — $85 of it a table that walked out (found later in the Garden with their glassware upstairs in 6A). Openers cut at 9, host out by 9:30. Maintenance: Garden fridge temping too high. No-shows charged. Favorite moment: table 71 left another hotel to come back and stay, calling us their 'safe bubble' and praising Care, Kayla, and Reagan.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Wed 7/15 (MOD: Kyler; Chef Steves).** A usual Wednesday with a nice bump around first seating and at 8pm. Net sales $4,372 beat the $4,218 target (+4%) on 125 guests / $35 check avg. Food $665, beverage $3,707, comps $164.72 (3.8%). Slightly apocalyptic weather — a swift rainstorm dropped temps from 100 to 88, then Canadian wildfire smoke built through the night; didn't stop foot traffic. Strong open (~25 covers before 6:15), quieted mid-evening, groups back at 8pm, then an 8-top at 11:45pm kept the room afloat to last call. Welcomed DCDC server Grant Menolascino to the 'mothership,' plus members Michael Faridi, Malcolm Hardy, Nikhil, and regulars Luke and Sara. Top sellers: Rosalie, Stepping Razor, Doves in the Wind. Two no-shows (not charged). Glass breakage: water glass, V martini, egg coupe, SOF.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Wed 7/15 (MOD: Julian; Chef Victor).** Net sales $5,055 landed essentially on the $5,060 target (99.9%) on 123 guests / $90.63 check avg. Started with 26 covers on the books, ended at 123. Slow start, then picked up heavy 9–10pm; good steady flow, started a waitlist but seated everyone with no hesitation. Xavier's first live shift — held his own. Bar and floor teams did great; skeleton crew rocked it. Food $1,001, comps $103. Kitchen banged out food in timely fashion, no complaints. 86 Way of the Warrior garnish. No incidents. Favorite moment: Julian's first live shift as a lead.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DCDC — Wed 7/15 (MOD: Marcus).** Lots of walk-ins despite the heat wave. Net sales (incl. events) $3,532.41 beat the $3,297 target (+7%) on 83 guests (26 reso / 57 walk-in). Marquee bar $3,532.41, food $510, total sales $3,885.69, comps $85.60. Toast transition going fairly well — a couple hiccups and one long-wait table that was recovered with popcorn and a thank-you. KDS in bar and kitchen buffering/timing out; reaching out to rep. Kitchen had a slow start then got hit all at once — James rocked it. Maintenance: service entrance flooring, curtains. No-shows charged. Favorite moment: guests' reaction to the AC on entering Marquee.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.weather: Partly cloudy, hot, light evening rain
venues.narrative: **Municipal Grand — Wed 7/15 (AM MOD: Braden/Lex; PM MOD: Justin/Drew).** Net sales $5,872 beat the $5,500 target (+7%) on 133 guests (18 AM / 115 PM). Splits: Muni Bar AM $968, Muni Bar PM $4,337, Sun Club $567, Hot Eye $0. Food $1,992, comps $50.20. Another Phish night in town plus the World Cup semifinal 3–5pm; restaurant saw a good pop right after 5 that died down after an hour, then ran the floor with 2 servers and an SA with ease. A few late groups came for drinks and stayed to close. Sun Club: lots of concert couples poolside for 2–3 hours, heavy on Hugo Spritzes. Brittany trained with Matt on the bar. No incidents. Favorite moment: Kyle Gibbons stopped in again with family; locals Manu and Chad by at end of night.
